description: Act for one person in Connect (2026-11-18, plan §L.2 Finance Experts): a first-party service named in Connect's service callers (Actor, Codes) calls Connect's MCP server as the person its token names (on_behalf_of). It is also the consent that lets that service mint such a token at openvibe.network, and then only for a person who signed in to that service. It reaches nothing by itself: only the apps and levels (read, or read and write) that person granted that service on the Apps page, a send, delete or pay action still asks the person, and OpenVibe's own apps answer with a delegated person token for one service and one call. Never grantable to apps.
